fields.label: What must the proposed specification change?

risks.mitigation: The builder records the actual detached head_sha in build_result, and the assessor uses that exact SHA rather than resolving the branch again.
risks.description: The named branch is mutable, so its ref could move between builder and assessor even though it currently resolves to db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef.

risks.mitigation: Run the prescribed observation suite exactly once and publish its real output and counts; if PostgreSQL or another dependency prevents execution, report that as the known issue without inventing results.
risks.description: The observation integration suite creates scratch PostgreSQL databases, so environmental availability can affect whether the builder test command runs.

risks.mitigation: Keep the builder detached and read-only, then publish the already-existing PR URL and branch exactly as authorized.
risks.description: PR 791 is already merged, but the verification workflow must still avoid commits, pushes, PR mutation, deployment, and database resets.

body.summary: The specification is implementable as written and needs no operator decision or correction. PR 791 and branch cohort/automatic-execution-lifecycle/73c9f2 resolve to head db2a5d49b8fbcaff9faf03094ddd0757b9c9ecef. Repository evidence supports three separate audit observations: grading_enabled defaults off and is replayed with ordered launch delivery; settlement writes are fenced to owner, attempt, status, and an unexpired lease after locking; and completion plus grade-observation append commit atomically. This analysis did not run the builder-prescribed test suite or modify the worktree.

findings.description: T1 is concrete and auditable. A present config with no grading_enabled is normalized to false in oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts:21-41; a launch mapping carries the committed config beside the input in oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts:14-49. The whole-config-absent case remains null in delivery and is treated as grading off downstream, so the assessor should distinguish absent field from absent config. Repository test definitions cover normalization in oakridge-dbos/tests/run-config.test.ts:56-83 and ordered delivery/replay in oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-publisher.test.ts:177-209.

The first half of T2 has an exact repository contract: current means status claimed, matching lease_owner, matching claim_attempt, and lease_expires_at later than database time. The execution row is locked before the predicate is evaluated and the authoritative update repeats the predicate in observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:194-228. The worker passes the same ExecutionClaim through request marking, completion, and failure in observation/src/grading/worker.ts:71-95. Stale-owner, stale-attempt, expired-lease, and lock-wait expiry cases are specified by observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:304-357.

The second half of T2 is separately verifiable: completeExecution updates the execution, closes the matching provider attempt, and inserts grade_observation inside one withTenant transaction in observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:248-293. The worker calls this single completion path in observation/src/grading/worker.ts:82-90. The rollback test forces the observation insert to fail and confirms neither completion nor answer persists in observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:231-244.

The prescribed verification command is available: the root package declares observation as a workspace in package.json:1-12, and observation/package.json:1-10 maps test to bun test ./tests. This supports the required bun run --filter observation test invocation and the requirement to publish actual counts/output rather than inferred results.

requirements.description: Produce exactly one cohort named audit with exactly two tasks T1 and T2; the requested topology and task boundaries are explicit.
T1 audits grading_enabled default-off semantics and committed ordered launch delivery at the named PR head.
T2 audits exact-current-claim fencing and atomic execution completion plus observation append at the named PR head.
The builder detaches at the named branch, performs no repository or remote mutation, runs the observation test suite once, publishes truthful build_result evidence, and publishes existing PR 791.

The assessor evaluates the same recorded commit, provides at least one finding per task with path:start-end code evidence, cites test/output evidence separately, and reports the builder run as test_evidence.
The brief introduces no additional operator choice; no unresolved operator-only decision was found.

source_spec_refs: Purpose: isolated verification of PR 791 with real analysis, plan, brief, build_result, and assessment artifacts
Audit topology: exactly one cohort named audit with two tasks
T1: grading_enabled default-off launch config and ordered launch delivery
T2: exact-current-claim fencing and transactional completion observation
Builder checkout, dependency, test, build_result, and existing-PR publication procedure
Assessor same-commit, per-task finding, code citation, output citation, and test_evidence requirements
No additional operator choice or confirmation
